question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To have a strong emotional effect on.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **"To overwhelm"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **To overwhelm** (अभिभूत करना) - To be overpowered emotionally or physically, or to inundate.

 
 
• **Example**: The support from everyone overwhelmed him during tough times.
 
 
 
• To overwhelm accurately expresses the given group of words "**To have a strong emotional effect on**".(पर गहरा भावनात्मक प्रभाव डालना।)

Therefore, the correct answer is "To overwhelm" 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To Forfeit** (हार मान लेना/जुर्माना) - Losing something or being forced to give up something as a penalty for wrongdoing or failure.
 
• **To Smother** (दबाना/घुटन) - To suffocate or cover closely or too much, often to suppress.
